Before we launch

Proposed launch policy for both website and app. This schedule must be shared and agreed before a paid booking is confirmed. All times use Indian Standard Time and the written pick-up time.

6 topics
01

How to cancel or change a booking

Contact GoRide by WhatsApp, email or phone with your booking reference. Cancellation is handled by the owner; there is currently no automatic cancellation or refund button. Written messages provide a timestamp. If calling, ask for written acknowledgement. Moving a booking is subject to availability and a fresh quote; ask before assuming the dates have changed.

02

Proposed cancellation schedule

Customer cancellation before pick-up
BookingNotice receivedCharge
Unaccepted requestAny timeNo charge
Self-drive24 hours or moreNo charge
Self-driveLess than 24 hours10% of agreed rental fare, capped at ₹500
Chauffeur1 hour or moreNo charge
ChauffeurLess than 1 hour10% of agreed rental fare, capped at ₹500

These are GoRide’s draft rates, not a claim that every rental company uses the same charges. Rental fare excludes the refundable deposit, tolls, parking and other pass-through charges. For example, a ₹4,000 fare has a ₹400 late-cancellation charge; a ₹7,000 fare is capped at ₹500. No separate cancellation administration fee applies.

If you do not arrive or contact GoRide, the applicable late-cancellation charge above is the maximum cancellation charge; the deposit is not automatically forfeited. After a rental starts, early return charges must follow the written quote; without a disclosed rule, agree a fair settlement for the service provided. Do not assume unused days automatically qualify for a full refund.

03

If GoRide cancels

If GoRide unilaterally cancels for operational reasons, all amounts paid for the unprovided service, including the deposit, are refundable. GoRide will also offer compensation equal to the cancellation charge a customer would have paid for the same booking and notice period. A replacement is your choice, not a condition of refund. No cancellation charge applies if GoRide rejects an unconfirmed request. Safety, eligibility disputes and events beyond either party’s control require a fair explanation and settlement under applicable law; this clause does not waive consumer remedies.

04

Refunds and deposit return

Proposed service target: initiate an undisputed cancellation refund within 5–7 working days after cancellation and a security-deposit return within 7 working days of return inspection. Refund to the original payer and payment method where possible; agree another verified method if needed. Bank or payment-provider processing can add time. These are manual service commitments, not automated app features.

GoRide must give you an itemised statement for deductions and return the undisputed deposit balance within that target. A documented disputed amount must have a reason and an expected resolution date; the whole deposit should not be held without justification. If a refund is delayed, contact GoRide for its status and transaction reference.

05

Before launch

The cancellation percentages and refund targets above are a proposed policy selected for GoRide. They require owner operational approval before paid bookings begin. Until then, the site remains a private preview and any proposed paid rental needs explicit written terms agreed by both parties.
